operatorNotes: The window is TERMINAL ON A P5 PAUSE. Four of the five precommitted items were started, executed exactly once and completed normally; two of those four produced zero raw page evidence, which is 2 of a frozen denominator of 5 and therefore above the 30% arm. The landed gate returned PAUSE_P5_LOW_RAW_YIELD after the FOURTH item.

Unlike Child Window A, the pause fired BEFORE the last item, so it genuinely suppressed work: P:55 was never started, has no run, no observation, no page and no sealed file, and remains NEVER_STARTED. That is the pause doing its job, and nothing was run around it.

The two zero-yield items share ONE mechanical shape, which is the material difference from Child Window A. P:51 and P:54 each produced exactly one gateway observation: a /robots.txt request with no HTTP status, error kind BLOCKED_BY_POLICY, robots_decision NOT_APPLICABLE, and resolved_ip_is_public false. Each root's hostname resolved, but every returned address was classified non-public, so the landed address guard refused the whole host before a socket was opened. Rule 18 behaving as designed.

This is a failure shape the corpus has not adjudicated before. Owner Clarification Q3 rank 3 enumerates its qualifying failures - DNS failure, TLS transport failure, CONNECT_TIMEOUT, READ_TIMEOUT before usable response completion, CONNECTION_REFUSED, CONNECTION_RESET - and BLOCKED_BY_POLICY is not among them; resolution here SUCCEEDED rather than failed. The adjudication must decide on its own evidence whether rank 3 or the rank 4 fallback applies, and must stop rather than guess if that is not mechanically decidable. Nothing is decided here.

P:52 answered 301 at /robots.txt to a target the landed continuationTargetFor accepted, so a continuation was issued and the policy was read. That is the same redirect SHAPE that left Child Window A's P:42 unreadable, where the target path was "/" instead. The capability was not widened; the difference is in the targets, not in the code.

P:52 and P:53 both ended at PAGE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with exactly 35 page attempts, the frozen ceiling reached rather than exceeded, and both yielded 34 raw pages. P:53 also recorded one BLOCKED_BY_POLICY row against a sibling host and was unaffected: it still obtained 38 HTTP responses.
P:52 is the only item whose SD7 count is a genuine range, [29, 30], from twelve near-duplicate edges. It is preserved complete, never forced to an exact value, and both ends are far above four.
Four candidate rows in P:53 carry a negative score, minimum -4.0000, which migration 0008's dropped CHECK is what permits.

AC power was attached throughout and no sleep, wake or DarkWake event occurred at any point in the acquisition interval. The bound power policy's battery-only authorisation was available but not needed.
